title: pytest -- unit testing, fixtures, parametrize, mocking
exp: For data engineering, testing transformation logic (given this input DataFrame, expect this output DataFrame) is the most important skill.
pts: pytest runs all test_*.py files and test_* functions.
@pytest.fixture creates reusable setup injected by parameter name.
@pytest.mark.parametrize runs the same test with multiple inputs.
unittest.mock.patch replaces a function with a MagicMock during the test.
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(result, expected) -- compares DataFrames including dtypes.

viz.note: pytest: test_*.py -> test_* functions -> fixtures injected by name -> assert with diff on failure.

qa.a:
**Elevator Pitch:** A fixture is a function decorated with @pytest.fixture providing reusable test setup. Pytest injects fixtures by matching function parameter names to fixture names. Shared fixtures go in conftest.py -- discovered automatically without importing.

**Under the Hood & Mechanics:** Transient creates a new instance on every request; Scoped creates one instance per HTTP request container; Singleton lives for the app domain lifespan. Capturing a Scoped service inside a Singleton captures the DbContext across requests, causing concurrency bugs.

**Production Failure Mode & Gotcha:** Instantiating new HttpClient() instances manually causes socket exhaustion in OS TIME_WAIT state under high concurrency. Fix: register typed clients with IHttpClientFactory to manage handler lifetimes and DNS refresh.

**Senior Trade-Off Signal:** IHttpClientFactory prevents socket leaks and manages DNS rotation, but requires explicit Polly retry and circuit breaker policies to prevent cascade failures during downstream outages.

qa.q: What should you prioritize testing in a data pipeline?
qa.a:
**Elevator Pitch:** Transformation logic: given this input DataFrame, produce this exact output. These are pure functions, fast to test, highest-consequence if wrong. Second priority: edge cases -- empty DataFrames, nulls in key columns, duplicate rows. Avoid testing framework code (pandas, SQLAlchemy) -- only test YOUR logic.

**Under the Hood & Mechanics:** Operating What should you prioritize testing in a data pipeline? at scale requires understanding the runtime lifecycle, memory allocations, and underlying execution constraints. The underlying framework or storage engine optimizes execution when contracts are explicitly preserved.

**Production Failure Mode & Gotcha:** Un-handled edge cases in What should you prioritize testing in a data pipeline? under high concurrent traffic can lead to performance degradation, unhandled exceptions, or unexpected memory growth. Always enforce defensive validation and error handling.

**Senior Trade-Off Signal:** Choosing this implementation approach balances developer velocity and system performance. Senior engineers evaluate latency, operational overhead, and maintenance costs before committing.
